name: web
description: Search, read, and research the web, through the providers you add: Keiro (BrowserFoundry), Firecrawl, Tavily, Exa, Brave, Perplexity, Parallel, Jina, Linkup, or your own SearXNG. It searches with no key, reads pages itself, and with the computer, in each bot's own browser.

providers.name: Keiro (BrowserFoundry)
providers.about: Search, read pages, answer, and research, on one key
steps: Open API Keys, and create one. Keiro has no address to check a key with, so press Try it on the web plugin's tab after adding it.

providers.name: Firecrawl
providers.about: Search, and read any page as Markdown
steps: Open API Keys, and copy your key, which starts with fc-.

providers.name: Firecrawl on your server
providers.about: Firecrawl you run yourself, with no key
providers.hint: In a container, localhost is fxbot's own: give the machine's address, as for Ollama. Give the address with /v2.

providers.name: Tavily
steps: Copy your API key, which starts with tvly-, from the overview.

providers.name: Exa
providers.about: Search by meaning, read pages, and answer
steps: Open API Keys, and create one.

providers.name: Brave Search
providers.about: Search its own index of the web
steps: Subscribe to a Search plan, then open API Keys and add one. Checking the key spends one search.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.about: Search with each page's text, and read pages
steps: Add credit, then create a key, which starts with pplx-.

providers.name: Parallel
steps: Open API Keys, and create one. Parallel has no address to check a key with, so press Try it on the web plugin's tab after adding it.

providers.name: Jina
providers.about: Read any page as Markdown, and search
steps: Copy the key the page shows, which starts with jina_. Checking one would spend its tokens, so press Try it on the web plugin's tab after adding it.

providers.name: Linkup
providers.about: Search, read pages, and answer with sources
steps: Copy your API key from the dashboard.

providers.name: SearXNG on your server
providers.about: Search many engines at once, on your own server
providers.hint: Its settings.yml must list json under search: formats. In a container, localhost is fxbot's own: give the machine's address, as for Ollama.

settings.name: freeSearch
settings.description: With no search provider added, search with Parallel's free search, which needs no key and gets each query
